notes.title: Demo Release for Steam Next Fest Jun 2025!
notes.notes:
Hello all!



We're excited to take part in Steam Next Fest June 2025 Edition! A demo is now LIVE!

In this demo, you will get to play one day in Ms. Meadows' life! You'll meet the first customer, chat, make tea, and write poetry inspired by your interaction! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455249/8eb422f729c10a0690315c084338e7fcde56f6e2.gif"]

We hope you enjoy this glimpse of the game while we gear up to releasing it fully later this year!



Much love, 

Blue Tango Street
